Today, I’m installing the PEAK Aluminum Railing System on my deck and showing you step by step how to install a glass railing yourself, including structural blocking, setting the posts, adding drainage, and installing the glass panels. If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Cheers! Watch all of the videos from the new project 👉🏼https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL34cQkzKfXWbw0cvItwuNkLOpdJF7gu18

If you want the high-end look of a custom glass deck railing without paying custom contractor prices, this PEAK glass railing system is a DIY-friendly option that gives you the engineered components you need to build a clean, professional-looking railing at home.
